# dsh-miliastra v0.6.3

**安装**：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.3` → 重启 `dsh web`
**Install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.3`, then restart `dsh web`.

[中文](#cn-v0.6.3) | [English](#en-v0.6.3)

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.3">🐛 问题修复</h3>

- **右键标记颜色会把"已选中的格"踢出列表** ⇒ 列表变 0、复制按钮全灰
  （作者原话：「我点了一次之后就不让复制了」）：右键当时复用了"切换选中"那个函数，
  给**已经选中**的格标颜色时它顺手把那格**移出**了选中。
  现在改用新的 **`gridSelAdd`（只加不减）** —— 标记颜色**绝不改变选中状态**，只保证那一格在列表里（已有就原样返回）。 @LoktLin
  - 回归钉住三件事：`gridSelAdd` 对已在列表里的格**原样返回**（不再踢人）、右键那段**不许再出现 `gridSelToggle`**、
    「既选中又标了色」的格在渲染层**仍留在列表里且「复制全部」可点**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.3-improve">🎨 体验优化</h3>

- **新增「移除失效行（N）」按钮**：步长改小之后，选中列表里可能留下"现在没有对应格"的行（它们不参与复制，
  但会一直占着列表、也让人以为"复制不了"）⇒ 一键清掉并如实报清了几行。**没有失效行时不显示**这个按钮。
  （纯函数 `gridSelPrune`：只保留当前网格里还存在的；不改入参，参数不合法时不动手。） @LoktLin
- 选中数量的写法顺了一点：`选中的格（1）　⚠️ 1 个现在没有对应格`（警告挪到括号外，原先挤在括号里读着别扭）。 @LoktLin

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.3-chores">⚠️ 其他变更</h3>

- **只改了 `lib/client.js` 一侧** ⇒ 装完/拉源码后**刷新页面（F5）**即可；Host 半边一个字没动、**不用重启 `dsh web`**。
- 这一版是 **0.6.2 的补丁**：0.6.2 里带着上面那个 bug（已发布），从 npm 装 0.6.2 的人请升到 0.6.3。
- **未做视觉验证**（开发机没有浏览器）：修复与两个按钮的启用条件由**真 React 静态渲染 + 源码断言**钉住
  （`client-render-test` **69** 条断言、全仓 **1407** 条断言）。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.6.2...v0.6.3

---

<h3 id="en-v0.6.3">🐛 Bug Fixes</h3>

- **Right-click colour marking removed the cell from the selection list** ⇒ the list dropped to 0 and every copy button greyed out
  (the author's words: "after I clicked once it won't let me copy anymore"). The right-click handler reused the *toggle* helper,
  so marking an **already-selected** cell also removed it from the selection.
  It now uses the new **`gridSelAdd` (add-only)** — marking a colour **never changes the selection**, it only guarantees the cell is
  in the list (and returns the same reference when it already is). @LoktLin
  - Three regressions pin it: `gridSelAdd` returns the list untouched for an existing cell (no more removals), the right-click handler
    **must not contain `gridSelToggle`**, and a cell that is both selected and marked **stays in the list with "copy all" enabled**.

<h3 id="en-v0.6.3-improve">🎨 Improvements</h3>

- **New "remove stale rows (N)" button**: after lowering a step, the selection list can hold rows that "no longer exist" (they do not take
  part in copying, yet they sit in the list and make it look like copying is broken) ⇒ one click clears them and reports how many went.
  The button is **hidden when there is nothing stale**. (Pure helper `gridSelPrune`: keeps only cells that exist in the current grid,
  never mutates its input, does nothing when the plan is invalid.) @LoktLin
- The selection count reads a little better now: `选中的格（1）　⚠️ 1 个现在没有对应格` (the warning moved outside the parentheses). @LoktLin

<h3 id="en-v0.6.3-chores">⚠️ Chores</h3>

- **Only `lib/client.js` changed** ⇒ after installing or pulling, a **page refresh (F5)** is enough; the Host half is untouched and
  **`dsh web` need not restart**.
- This is a **patch on top of 0.6.2**: 0.6.2 shipped with the bug above, so anyone installing 0.6.2 from npm should move to 0.6.3.
- **No visual verification** (no browser on the dev machine): the fix and both buttons' enable conditions are pinned by
  **real React static render + source assertions** (`client-render-test` **69** assertions, **1407** across the repo).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.6.2...v0.6.3
